description.value:
Applied by Fading Ward to the target.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC and to all saving throws for the duration. When the duration ends, the target takes a -1 status penalty to AC and to all saving throws for 1 minute afterward. The later cost is not a risk and cannot be avoided, resisted, or dispelled — it is the same bargain the Reckoning is, in miniature.

cinderfall.incomplete: The target's own text also promises a -1 status penalty to AC and saving throws for 1 minute after the ward's duration ends -- not modeled. No rule element chains a follow-up Effect automatically at expiry (no on-expiry/on-delete-grant key found anywhere in pf2e-source's rule-element list; GrantItem's onDeleteActions only restricts deletion propagation, it does not create anything). Would need a second, GM-manually-applied Effect item, matching this corpus's existing trigger-effect convention -- a reasonable extrapolation, not a proven precedent, so flagged rather than built. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md open question 2.
